params.lyrics:
[Opening - quiet - low energy, spacious]
You don't have to have everything figured out today.
You just have to take the next step.

[Vulnerability - uncertain - low energy, spacious]
Every challenge you've faced has taught you something,
and every setback has given you another chance to grow.
There will be moments when you doubt yourself.

[Reflection - reflective - low energy, spacious]
There will be moments when the path ahead feels uncertain.
But courage isn't the absence of doubt.
It's choosing to move forward anyway.
One step becomes another.

[Gentle Hope - hopeful - moderate energy]
And eventually you look back and realize
that the person who was afraid to begin
became the person who kept going.

[Quiet Resolution - resolved - low energy, spacious]
You are not finished.
You're still becoming.
Take the next step.

Vocal character: clear warm English vocal, sincere storytelling delivery.
Core instrumentation palette: piano, strings, light percussion.
Narrative arc name: phase2_intimate_arc.
Phase 2 intimate arc: restrained structural progression without large climax.
Musical narrative progression with approximate timing:
- 0–8s [opening]: arrival; mood quiet; low energy, spacious; instrumentation piano, ambient_pad; vocal delivery intimate.
- 8–18s [vulnerability]: vulnerability; mood uncertain; low energy, spacious; instrumentation piano, soft_strings; vocal delivery fragile.
- 18–30s [reflection]: introspection; mood reflective; low energy, spacious; instrumentation piano, soft_strings, light_pad; vocal delivery restrained.
- 30–40s [gentle_hope]: gentle_hope; mood hopeful; moderate energy; instrumentation piano, strings; vocal delivery warm.
- 40–48s [quiet_resolution]: peace; mood resolved; low energy, spacious; instrumentation piano, light_strings; vocal delivery quiet.
Do not rely on lyric section labels; follow this timed musical narrative through arrangement density, rhythm, and vocal intensity alone.
params.lyrics:
You don't have to have everything figured out today.
You just have to take the next step.
Every challenge you've faced has taught you something,
and every setback has given you another chance to grow.
There will be moments when you doubt yourself.
There will be moments when the path ahead feels uncertain.
But courage isn't the absence of doubt.
It's choosing to move forward anyway.
One step becomes another.
And eventually you look back and realize
that the person who was afraid to begin
became the person who kept going.
You are not finished.
You're still becoming.
Take the next step.
